findings.text: The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: RQCLA-1: The change correctly adds `zbuild:claimed` before the first stage dispatches, but it caused `tests/e2e/parity-local-vs-ci-test.sh` to fail — the golden snapshot at `tests/golden/parity/event-sequence.golden` was not updated to include the four events the claim coordinator now emits: `plugin.claim.start` and `plugin.claim.complete` (after `pipeline.start`, before the first stage) and `plugin.release.start` and `plugin.release.complete` (at run end). The diff the test reports is `2a3,4 > plugin.claim.start > plugin.claim.complete` and `114a117,118 > plugin.release.start > plugin.release.complete`. The code is correct; the golden file was not regenerated, leaving the test suite in a failing state. — tests/golden/parity/event-sequence.golden | memory.backend.init — ACCEPTED IF: When the issue has no `zbuild:claimed` label, the run adds it before the first stage dispatches
